what: Pressing the add button sends an accent dot (26px, 2px background-color border) flying from the button center to the cart button center — a smooth curve through three points (start·middle·end, curviness 1), and the middle point wobbles randomly within ±30px up and down each time, so every press draws a slightly different arc. It speeds up and plugs in over 1.1s power2.in and vanishes at 1.09s, and on arrival it sends fx:arrive to the element (that is when the added line is appended)

options.to: CSS selector of the destination (found in the document), default [data-fx-part="cart"] — if missing or hidden, it skips the flight and goes straight to fx:arrive
options.sway: Wobble width of the middle point (px), default 30 — 0 gives the same straight arc every time

note: The dot is attached to body with position: fixed and removed afterward. Each flight spawns a new dot, so repeated presses overlap. With reduce it doesn’t fly and fires fx:arrive immediately.

from.where: detail.js [data-add] (product header add·small add bar below) → hand-drawn cart circle at top right. Original bundle MotionPathPlugin path [start, center ±30 wobble, end] curviness 1, 1.1s power2.in, opacity 0 at 1.09s
